holdout_card.fact_statement: The Spanish government approved €10.6 billion in fiscal aid for people affected by the 2024 Spanish floods.
holdout_card.source_span: approved a decree to provide €10.6 billion (amounting to €60,000 per household) in fiscal aid to people affected by the floods.
